def generate_inputs(device):
    x = torch.zeros(128, 3, 16, 32, 32, device=device, dtype=torch.float32)
    # Create batch-varying baseline with spatial jitter
    for b in range(128):
        baseline = (b - 64) * 0.05  # Range: [-3.2, 3.15]
        # Add deterministic spatial pattern to break race-uniformity
        spatial_pattern = torch.arange(16*32*32, device=device, dtype=torch.float32).reshape(16, 32, 32)
        spatial_pattern = (spatial_pattern % 256) * 0.002 - 0.256  # Range: [-0.256, 0.254]
        for c in range(3):
            x[b, c, :, :, :] = baseline + spatial_pattern + c * 0.01
    return [x]
